units.source_text: 这些日子，我为了道子似睡非睡，近于遐想，异常兴奋。

en.t: These days, because of Michiko, I had been half asleep and half awake, almost lost in reverie, and unusually excited.

units.source_text: 现在连日的困顿登时涌了上来，我的棋越下越糟了。

en.t: Now the exhaustion of the past several days suddenly came over me, and my go grew worse with every move.
